title: Tech View and Board View show only this organization and location
custom_preconds:
1. Two organizations on the build under test: A (your usual test organization) and B. If you have no second organization, sign up a new one on the QA build (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Org B").
  2. In organization B: add an eligible technician "ZZAUTOTEST OrgB Tech" (Settings > Staff) and a work order for customer "ZZAUTOTEST OrgB Customer" led by that technician.
  3. In organization A: a second location (Settings > Locations) with a work order for customer "ZZAUTOTEST Loc2 Customer" led by a technician enrolled only there.
  4. Sign in to organization A as a dispatcher whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit (check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > on the Work Orders card, View and Create & Edit are both ticked. The Admin role has both).
  5. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (the display switcher only shows at 1024 px and wider).
  6. Note for the tester: the server-side scoping and the organization check on a technician sent with a reassignment are developer/automated checks. By hand, confirm only that nothing from organization B, or from the other location, is ever shown or offered.
custom_steps:
1. In organization A, at your usual location, open Work Orders > All.
  2. Search "OrgB".
  3. Click Tech View in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar (the design tooltip reads "By Lead Tech").
  4. Click Board View in the display switcher (the design tooltip reads "Board").
  5. Search "Loc2" in both views.
  6. Open any card's more-actions > "Reassign lead technician" and search "OrgB Tech", then cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Steps 2 to 4: no work order, group or column from organization B appears in either view.
  • Step 5: the other location's work order and its technician do not appear at this location.
  • Step 6: the dialog offers no organization B technician.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; Work Orders Board View & Tech View Display Options Technical Implementation Plan (revised 24 Sep 2026, uploaded 8 Oct 2026), section 1.2 (NFR-006), section 1.4 (tenant check on inbound technician id) and section 9 (security).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • Tech plan NFR-006: “Every new query is scoped by workplace and organization.”
  • Tech plan 1.4 tenant check: “Add organization-ownership check (eligibility stays the picker's job per the PRD)”

AUTOMATION: HOLD - server-side scoping is a developer/automated check; the two-org observation is manual, not yet build-verified on the Work Orders QA build
